prop.notes: Basic bool/scalar/string/enum/color/vector paths implemented. Numeric properties now have rotation/length/area/volume scene-unit conversion, preferred length units, factor percentages, unchanged-value preservation, click-to-type, BVT-style drag steps, Shift precision, Ctrl snapping, soft/hard limits and slider flag behavior. Menu fields share the codec and raw RNA context target. Wide numeric motion uses 15% amplitude. Custom event-only scalar INT/ENUM and full-event KeyMapItem.type capture now share glass menus, cancellation, stale-owner checks and atomic host commits; keyboard/mouse/chord cases are execution-tested. See docs/EVENT_PROPERTIES.md. Tested on macOS Blender 5.1.2/5.2.2; exact reference acceptance, pointer props, remaining event variants, decorators, full math/driver syntax, other unit categories and complete prop keyword/subtype semantics remain open. See docs/NUMERIC_PROPERTIES.md.

active_blender_theme.notes: Production default uses original BVT public widget RGB extraction, immutable bounded caches and shared semantic roles across basic controls, selection menus and all eight compound cards. Reference policy is explicit. liquid_glass.notes: Mandatory BVT shared backdrop, Gaussian strong blur, refraction/rim and finite motion for every translucent surface. Exact generated-reference acceptance and broader theme/platform matrix remain open.
